The '''Rian-327 airspeeder''' was a model [[airspeeder]]<ref name="VE" /> that existed the final years of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="ROTS" /> One red and silver Rian-327 was owned by [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]].<ref name="VE" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|III}}</ref> Amidala's airspeeder was parked on a special landing platform next to another vehicle when [[Captain]] [[Gregar Typho]] walked Amidala to her [[J-type Naboo star skiff]] which she then [[Duel on Mustafar|to travel]] to her husband [[Anakin Skywalker]] on [[Mustafar]].<ref name="ROTS" />
